No operator with that name could be independently located to confirm exactly what currently occupies the building on Susan B. Britt Court, a light industrial street in Winter Garden, but the name itself carries no indication of IT, hosting, or telecommunications activity, and light industrial buildings on streets of this kind are typically small manufacturing, fabrication, or distribution operations rather than commercial data centers. Manufacturers of foam packaging and cushioning materials commonly run ordinary office and production floor computer systems, an internal server closet at most, which is an entirely different function from a facility built to lease power, cooling, and rack space to outside tenants. Absent any confirmed business record, press mention, or operator site describing data center, colocation, or hosting services at this address, the honest conclusion is that the data center tag here most likely reflects a mapping error rather than an actual data center.

reading.body:
E-Foam in Winter Garden, Florida is almost certainly not a data center: it has no operator, no website, no published power figure, and its name points to foam fabrication or packaging rather than IT hosting.

The mapping tag appears to be an error. The address sits on a light industrial street, and the name E-Foam carries no indication of data center, colocation, or telecommunications activity. Research found no operator site, press mention, or business record confirming hosting services at this address.

This matters for AI capacity accounting because Florida's published data center footprint is already small. Four facilities in the state publish power figures totaling 9.35 MW; E-Foam is mapped but publishes nothing, so it cannot be counted as capacity. Among thirteen facilities mapped in Florida, only a small fraction release power data, and this one is not among them.

What the data does not show is equally clear. No specifications exist to assess whether the site contributes to Florida's grid load or AI compute. Until independent verification establishes data center operations at this address, it should be excluded from active tracking and from any estimate of AI infrastructure in the state.
